photos.desc: Residential building Babenwohlweg 9 in Bregenz, Vorarlberg, Austria. It dates from the 16th century. Viewing on the occasion of the day of the monument 2024
Hylotrupes bajulus , Male. Soucheres Basses, Turin
Not indigenous, but locally a long-established pest in untreated dry timber, especially wood or dead trees of Conifera. One common name is "Italian beetle"
